normative_extracts.quote: A selector’s specificity is calculated as a three-component tuple (A, B, C) counting ID selectors, class/attribute/pseudo-class selectors, and type/pseudo-element selectors.

browser_support.notes: Core specificity is CSS1; zero-specificity :where() and forgiving :is() are Baseline Widely Available.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Style engine sorts matched declarations by Origin/Importance -> @layer -> (A,B,C) -> Order, then copies inherited properties from parent ComputedStyle.

production_failures.symptom: Utility class .mt-4 fails to override a component rule .card p
production_failures.root_cause: .card p has specificity (0, 1, 1) which beats .mt-4 at (0, 1, 0), regardless of source order.
production_failures.mitigation: Wrap component defaults in :where(.card p) for (0, 0, 0) specificity or place them in a lower @layer.

production_failures.symptom: Color set on <body> does not apply to <button> or <input>
production_failures.root_cause: User-agent stylesheets explicitly set color and font on form controls, blocking inheritance from <body>.
production_failures.mitigation: Explicitly declare color: inherit; font: inherit; on form controls in your reset layer.
